issues: The page called appending &filter= or &mode= to a GetUrl result an edge case. The description lists these as patterns the review does not flag. The actual edge cases are the runtime error for an unpublished SOAP/OData object and UseFilters returning an empty string.
The page said GetUrl should be used for all client links. The rule covers only links into the running environment's client; external URLs, fixed endpoints and URLs from setup are excluded.
